title: A knot is a betweenness: the disagreement count determines every not-all-equal base
claim: For any set of allowed states, c lies between a and b in the disagreement count iff no state has a = b != c; a not-all-equal knot abc holds iff the three counts sum to 2N; the disagreement table determines every nonempty not-all-equal base on n >= 4 distinctions (and, with N, every base of complement-closed constraints on at most three places) and fails at n = 3 (one knot against none); parity is invisible to pairs (four-place parity on five distinctions inside the complement-closed class); the counts are additive along an order iff every state is a threshold (the line 2|i - j|); a base-point chain of m distinctions allows at most 2m of their joint values; on not-all-equal patterns with no cycle of knots the rate is (1 - (-1/3)^s)/2, so -log_3 |1 - 2d/N| equals steps apart.
standard_statement: Hamming distance between columns of a Boolean relation; metric betweenness (Menger); tight triangle facets of the cut polytope; NAE_3 as a degree-2 predicate; determination of conjunctions of complement-closed constraints of arity <= 3 (inside co-clone IN2) by pairwise agreement counts; pairwise independence of parity; line metrics as sums of nested cuts; binary symmetric Markov model on a tree and its additive log-correlation distance (Cavender-Farris-Neyman).
prior_work: Menger 1928; Deza and Laurent 1997; Boehler, Reith, Schnoor and Vollmer 2005; Neyman 1971; Farris 1973; Cavender 1978; in the program OVERLAP-READ-20261111-001 (the law reads pair counts of knots, the dual), RANDOM-FATES-20261112-001 (bond distance steps + 1 on knot trees), EMERGENCE-BITS-20261021-001.
completion_gate: check.py passes (every set of states on three and four distinctions; every NAE relation on three to six; every signed complement-closed relation on four and five; 301 knot trees), the referee thread reviews the proofs, and each statement keeps its provenance label.

validation.independence: check.py enumerates states and decodes by the proof's own rules, separately from the experiment's frontier programme; same task authorship; referee pending
validation.novelty: elementary and likely folklore (statements 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 known; 3 and 6 local in this form)
